_comment: EARNED, not aspired to. A profile lands here only after a run proved the number; each raise is a deliberate commit. A profile that is absent prints a baseline and passes — the first measurement of anything must not fail a build.

Rupanjana Mitra._note: The floor is 0.00 because that is what production earns today: none of the 40 listings the yardstick shortlists can be reached on /market at all. The ceiling is what it shows that should not be there. Both move one way.
